answer: Before a new key can steer a grading panel, it must finish a measured voyage of attested labor that peers can replay from the ledger. Each countersigned settlement is cut into a public crystal of work history, held to the light and checked for fractures. Only after that trail survives inspection is influence hammered in a slow forge of non-kin review. Aliases can multiply overnight, yet they cannot skip the miles or the heat, so flooding seats stays costlier than the seats are worth.
